def transform(grid):
    """Shift all non-background cells down by 1 row."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = grid[0][0]
    non_bg_positions = [(i, j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j] != bg]
    
    # Create new grid with background

    for i, j in non_bg_positions:
